map.计算填筑料干密度与压实度，判定压实质量是否达标: From wet density, water content and maximum dry density, compute compacted dry density and degree of compaction and check it against specification for earth-rock dam and embankment fill.

map.压实度标准：1级坝≥98%，2级≥96%，3级≥94%（DL/T 5395）: Compaction standard: class 1 dam ≥98%, class 2 ≥96%, class 3 ≥94% (DL/T 5395)
map.含水量控制范围一般为最优含水量 ±2%: Water content is usually controlled within ±2% of optimum

map.碾压参数（遍数、层厚）定干密度。: Rolling params (passes, lift thickness) set dry density.
map.含水率偏离最优时复压调整。: Recompact when water content deviates from optimum.
map.现场干密度 2.05、最大干密度 2.12 → 压实度 = 2.05/2.12: Field dry density 2.05, max dry density 2.12 → compaction = 2.05/2.12 ≈ 96.7%, meets the ≥96% requirement.
map.最优含水 12.5%、实测 10% 偏干，洒水复压可提密度。: Optimum 12.5%, measured 10% (too dry); sprinkling and rerolling raises density.
map.干密度是实测，压实度是现场干密度与室内最大干密度之比，控制指标。: Dry density is measured; compaction is the ratio of field to lab max dry density — the control index.
map.近最优含水时易压实到高密度，过干或过湿都难达标。: Near optimum water, high density is easy; too dry or too wet both fail.
map.土石坝填筑密度控制工具用于土石坝填筑施工质量评定。根据实测湿密度、含水量计算干密: The earth-rock dam fill density control tool grades fill quality. From measured wet density and water content it computes dry density, compares with design dry density for compaction, and with optimum-water deviation judges pass/fail — a key tool for earth-rock dam construction quality control.
